data.name: Haziqa
data.gender_notes: Haziqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hazaj' which means 'to be gentle, delicate or subtle'. In Islamic history, Haziqa is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her gentle and delicate nature. The name Haziqa carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Subtle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haziqa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, subtle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Haziqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate, Subtle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haziqa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This name holds significant spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition, emphasizing the importance of remembrance and mindfulness of God.
